blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While he declined to answer questions on what was the cause of the pressure on the prosecution panel, former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV has called out Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero for singling him out regarding the issuance of subpoenas. In a press briefing on Friday, Trillanes said he really wants to address the reason why he asked the prosecution to remove him from the list of witnesses for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, but he is concerned that his explanation might overshadow his revelations.
